links.outcome: Extraction performance with versus without RAG-enhanced few-shot prompting
links.effect: Few-shot prompting improved baseline accuracy and RAG further enhanced performance, particularly for models under 24B parameters; Mistral Small 24B with RAG nearly matched Llama 70B (F1 > 0.90).
links.quote: Prompting strategy significantly impacted performance: few-shot prompting improved baseline accuracy, and RAG further enhanced performance, particularly for models with fewer than 24B parameters.
